content_of_post_to_comment: I’m finding myself diving really hard into escapism which I know has just become an over indulged habit. I feel like I’m waiting for time to just fast forward and that’s unrealistic because the only way to get to where I really want in life is by starting to implement all the changes I want to making and being disciplined in the follow through of changing my habits. Any suggestions on what works for you because my lists and checking boxes, setting timers manage my focus, etc are no longer working. I need suggestions to help put myself in motivation mode. Right now I’m doing the bare minimum to not self destruct and implode my life like still getting up for work, checking in socially with friends, making sure I eat something but everything feels like a devastating overwhelming chore and I just want to hide under the covers and never move and this fluffy “taking care of yourself intentionally to fuel the person you want to be” and “act like you’re already the better version of yourself/setting yourself up to be the better version of yourself” mentality isn’t cutting it enough to deter me from becoming a low existing blob. Thanks in advance.
comment: I relate to the part about doing the bare minimum just to keep things from falling apart. Sometimes when every task feels like a mountain, adding more systems and discipline hacks can become another source of pressure. I’ve found it helps to shrink the goal from “fix my life” to one small action that proves I can still influence my day. What’s one thing that feels slightly less impossible right now?
